description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent loses 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.
